title: Backup registry mutation handlers
observed_behavior: Before this slice, the reactor handled backup run, restore, restore approval, and retention request kinds only.
backupRequestKinds() omitted the reserved repository register, policy apply, recipe apply, definition apply, repository probe, and verification request kinds.
intended_behavior: Authorized addressable backup command events for the six missing reserved request kinds are parsed, validated, handled, and answered with signed Nostr result events.
Backup repository, policy, recipe, and definition apply requests mutate the backup registry through control-plane handlers.
Backup repository probe and verification requests validate targets, publish queued results, and invoke configured control-plane executors without polling or timeout-based completion logic.
